content.text: Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in Zimbabwe, where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-first-principles-definitive|digital]] creators struggle to collect payments. This infrastructure guide builds a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] store on Cloudflare Pages, bypassing platform restrictions without sacrificing data ownership. With Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy a digital store in 4-6 hours or 48 hours, respectively, and start accepting crypto payments for free. This guide walks you through the deployment process, from [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-3|Setting Up]] up your payment and delivery pipeline to scaling your infrastructure once it's running. By the end, you'll have a fully functional digital store on Cloudflare Pages, processing crypto payments without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When Stripe and PayPal are unavailable in your region, it's challenging to collect payments for digital products. This infrastructure, built on Cloudflare Pages, supplants these platforms with a sovereign digital commerce stack. By deploying a free hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, you can own your data and payment processing without relying on Stripe or PayPal. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, and with Supabase, you can store orders securely. This infrastructure is not a workaround but a base-layer solution that gives you full control over your digital store.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to create a GitHub or Cloudflare account, depending on your chosen hosting solution. You'll also need to sign up for NOWPayments and Supabase accounts to integrate payment processing and order storage. Additionally, you'll need to have a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Make sure you have a digital product ready to sell, and choose your desired payment and delivery pipeline configuration. With these essentials in place, you're ready to deploy your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site. This involves creating a new project in NOWPayments, configuring your payment settings, and then adding a payment button to your site. Next, you'll need to set up Supabase to store orders securely. This involves creating a new Supabase project, configuring your project settings, and then integrating Supabase with your Cloudflare Pages site. Finally, you'll need to configure your file delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This involves creating a new Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account, configuring your file delivery settings, and then integrating it with your Cloudflare Pages site.
You can deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages in 4-6 hours with Sovereign Starter Stack ($97).
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live. Test your site to ensure everything is working as expected, and then process your first transaction. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, and with Supabase, you can store orders securely. Make sure to configure your payment settings correctly to avoid any issues during your first transaction. Once your transaction is processed, you can deliver your digital product to your customer using your configured file delivery pipeline.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your infrastructure once it's running, you'll need to monitor your site's performance and adjust your configuration as needed. Make sure to optimize your database and file delivery pipeline to handle increased traffic. With Cloudflare Pages, you can easily scale your site by adding more workers or upgrading your plan. Additionally, you can use Supabase to store orders securely and NOWPayments to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies. By monitoring your site's performance and adjusting your configuration, you can scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question a reader would ask is: Can I accept crypto payments on my digital store without relying on Stripe or PayPal? The answer is yes. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, and with Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy a digital store in 4-6 hours or 48 hours, respectively, and start accepting crypto payments for free. This infrastructure guide provides a step-by-step deployment process, from setting up your payment and delivery pipeline to scaling your infrastructure once it's running.
With Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can deploy a digital store in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, and includes 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and 30-day support.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a more advanced digital store solution, consider Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, and includes 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and 30-day support. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. You can also explore our other products, such as Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or our complete Builder Kit ($197).
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, follow these steps: Create a GitHub or Cloudflare account to host your site. Sign up for NOWPayments and Supabase accounts to integrate payment processing and order storage. Create a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Configure your payment and delivery pipeline by integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site and setting up Supabase to store orders securely. Configure your file delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your site to ensure everything is working as expected. Process your first transaction using NOWPayments. Deliver your digital product to your customer using your configured file delivery pipeline.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up my payment and delivery pipeline?

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site, configure your payment settings, and then add a payment button to your site. Next, you'll need to set up Supabase to store orders securely, configure your project settings, and then integrate Supabase with your Cloudflare Pages site. Finally, you'll need to configure your file delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Can I accept multiple cryptocurrencies on my digital store?

Yes, with NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies on your digital store. This means that your customers can choose their preferred cryptocurrency for payment, and you can receive payments in the cryptocurrency of their choice.
How do I store orders securely on my digital store?

To store orders securely on your digital store, you'll need to set up Supabase, a secure and scalable database solution. You'll then need to configure your project settings and integrate Supabase with your Cloudflare Pages site. This will ensure that your orders are stored securely and can be accessed easily.
What is the difference between Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a basic digital store solution that deploys in 4-6 hours, includes 3 products loaded, and provides 30-day support. Edge Commerce Stack ($197), on the other hand, is an advanced digital store solution that deploys in 48 hours, includes 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and provides 30-day support. Additionally, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments.
Can I use Cloudflare Pages to host my digital store?

Yes, Cloudflare Pages is a suitable hosting solution for your digital store. You can create a GitHub or Cloudflare account, configure your Cloudflare Pages site, and then deploy your digital store using Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
